turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I fainted in the library on Friday and woke up with a security guard over me.
What went through your mind then?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. That is how it was.
What happened next?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
What went through your mind then?
The GP did blood tests and said my potassium is low and I need to come back next week.
What happened next?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I think so, yes.
Mm-hm. Go on.
Aisha made pasta and sat with me until I ate half of it, and I hated her for it.
Tell me more about that.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. Yes, it was like that.
Tell me more about that.
I cannot tell my father about any of this, he would say I am being dramatic.
What happened next?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. Yes, it was like that.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
